capabilities: : Open links with Vimium-style hint labels
intentEvidence: This plugin brings the same muscle memory to reading mode and webview tabs — scroll with j/k, jump to top/bottom with gg/G, open links with Vimium-style hint labels, and more.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim mode only works in edit mode, leaving reading mode and webview tabs without similar muscle memory.
summary: Provides Vim-style keyboard navigation for Obsidian's reading mode and built-in web browser.
